title: 'Not under any house arrest': Leh Police withdraw security arrangements outside Sonam Wangchuk's home

ai.summary: Leh police withdrew security arrangements around climate activist Sonam Wangchuk's home, clarifying he was not under house arrest despite claims he was confined after being taken from a protest site.

facts.quote: Leh Police on Friday night removed security arrangements put in place to ensure compliance with a prohibitory order imposed on climate activist Sonam Wangchuk in Leh, officials said.

facts.claim: Wangchuk was not under house arrest
facts.quote: The police further stated that the prohibitory order had been issued by the Additional District Magistrate (ADM) of Leh and denied claims that Wangchuk was under house arrest.

facts.claim: Wangchuk alleged he was confined after being taken from a protest site
facts.quote: The activist alleged that he was confined to his residence after being taken away from a protest site and escorted home on November 11.

facts.claim: Wangchuk claimed security personnel restricted his movement
facts.quote: Earlier, Wangchuk, a prominent member of the Leh apex body (LAB), alleged that around 20-25 police and paramilitary personnel had been stationed outside his residence, restricting his movement.

ai.background_note: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk, a key figure in the Ladakh statehood movement, is involved in protests related to the upcoming elections to the Autonomous Hill Development Councils scheduled for December 4.
